caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with a primarily light, off-white or cream-colored field. There are wide decorative borders at both the top and bottom edges, each featuring geometric patterns dominated by black, green, white, and red colors. The upper border displays a series of black zigzag patterns, interspersed with vertical green and white lines and some small triangle and diamond shapes. The lower border is wider, with a series of alternating red and white diamond motifs and cross shapes on a black background, also interspersed with green vertical lines and bordered by zigzag and triangular black and white designs. The textile has tassels at each of its four corners, shaded in a mix of gray, black, and a hint of red in the bottom two corners. There is a small, faint inscription along the bottom edge of the textile on the drawing. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Indian Blanket
